parts.description: Pure-Rust engine. No Tauri, no networking.
Open a vault, list the tree, read and write notes atomically, fidelity check.
The command registry: every core feature is a named command with JSON in and out.
Disposable SQLite index: full-text search, links, backlinks, graph, tags.
Read and change a note's properties without touching the rest of the file.
File watcher: report changes made outside the app.
Sync engine: keeps a vault's files and their CRDT documents in step and talks to the relay.
The relay: accounts' workspaces, roles, invites, the update log and live fan-out.
The `lokus` binary: run any core command against a real vault.
Tauri shell. Thin: forwards commands to the core, owns windows and the dev channel.
App frame: layout, tabs, command palette, quick switcher, design tokens, UI command registry.
The only UI code that talks to Rust, the network, Supabase or PostHog.
CodeMirror 6 editor: live preview, auto-pairing, markdown commands.
Sidebar file tree.
Page header: cover, icon, title, properties (stored in frontmatter).
Full-text search palette.
Linked mentions under a note.
Graph of notes and links. Loaded only when opened.
Table and board views over the notes in a folder, driven by their properties.
Team workspaces: connect, create, join, members, invites.
Login screen and session state.
Product analytics events and the opt-out. Never sends note content.
Scripts that enforce the hard rules.
